wargear.name: Shadow-banner
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A dull black standard of dark feathers that seems to drink the light around it. Every model in the unit gains +1 Intelligence and Shrouded (6+).

wargear.name: Corvid dirge-shroud
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tattered mourning-cloak worn over the armour of the Isstvan survivors, hiding the bearer in smoke and sorrow. The model gains Shrouded (6+).

option.text: The Sergeant may carry lightning claws
The Shade may carry a Shade-cut blade
Any Mor Deythan may exchange their Nemesis bolter for
Any Dark Fury may exchange their talons for
Any Deliverer may wear a Corvid dirge-shroud
The unit may carry a Shadow-banner
The unit may be issued Cameleoline cloaks

modifiers.text: Survivors who will not be hurried: +1 LD, -1 M.
Lean fighters of the shadow war: +1 M, -1 LD.

rites.name: Wings of the Corvid
rites.flavor: A hundred shapes drop out of the smoke, and by the time you count them they are among you.
rites.text: Dark Fury Squads, Assault Squads and Destroyer Assault Squads may fill Troops slots. Every Antigrav Infantry unit gains Fast (1) and Shrouded (6+). The wings leave the heavy things behind: no Armour, Heavy Transport or Terminator squads, and at least one Dark Fury Squad is required.

modifiers.text: Wings of the Corvid: Fast (1), Shrouded (6+).

require.note: Bring at least one Dark Fury Squad.

rites.name: Whispers in the Dark
rites.flavor: The enemy never sees the first hundred. The hundred and first is already behind him.
rites.text: Reconnaissance Squads, Scout Squads and Mor Deythan Squads may fill Troops slots. Reconnaissance and Scout Squads gain Infiltrate (6) and Shrouded (6+). Stealth demands light feet: no Armour, Support, Heavy Transport, War Engine or Lord of War units, and at least one Reconnaissance or Scout Squad is required.

modifiers.text: Whispers in the Dark: Infiltrate (6), Shrouded (6+).

require.note: Bring a Reconnaissance or Scout Squad.

rites.name: Survivors of the Black Dirge
rites.flavor: Isstvan took the Legion's wings. What was left learned to stand.
rites.text: Deliverers Squads may fill Troops slots, cost 40 points less and gain Line (1). All non-vehicle models gain +1 Willpower. Those who survive do not strike first: no Recon or Fast Attack units, and the army must be led by Corvus Corax. At least one Deliverers Squad is required.

modifiers.text: Survivors of the Black Dirge: Line (1).
Survivors of the Black Dirge: +1 WP.

require.note: Bring at least one Deliverers Squad.

rites.name: Knives Among the Stars
rites.flavor: One blade, one name, one quiet corridor, and the war ends before it begins.
rites.text: Moritat, Moritat Mortalis, Pathfinders and Kaedes Nex cost 15 points less and gain Shrouded (5+). The cost is the army's body: no Retinue or Heavy Assault units, at most one High Command unit, and at least two of Moritat, Moritat Mortalis, Pathfinder or Kaedes Nex.

limit.note: At most one High Command unit.
